prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a vertical mid-thigh swimwear editorial of an adult woman standing naturally on wet sand at a beach at dusk. She has long dark-brown wavy hair, a tanned complexion, minimal natural makeup, and wears a yellow floral two-piece swimsuit with subtle ruffled edges and small hoop earrings. Keep her upright and relaxed with arms naturally at her sides. Behind her, show gentle ocean waves with distant beachgoers, a tall resort silhouette, palm trees, and a twilight sky shifting from warm orange at the horizon to dusky purple. Use ambient sunset backlight combined with direct on-camera flash for a crisp subject and softly darkened background; preserve realistic skin texture and wet-sand reflections. Keep it fashion-editorial and non-sexualized. No text, logo, or watermark.
